verdict.rationale: Runloop documents its own recipe for running a coding agent inside its sandbox: an OpenCode tutorial using a blueprint workflow. It also documents mounting pre-configured AI agents into Devboxes, and Agent Gateways that let agents call Anthropic and OpenAI APIs without exposing keys. However, no first-party recipe specifically for Claude Code or Codex appears in the evidence, and the agent-mount docs do not say which agents are supported. Missing for 10: an explicit Claude Code recipe, an explicit Codex recipe, a list of supported agent mounts, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run coding agents like Claude Code or Codex inside the sandbox following the vendor's own recipe

citations.quote: Run OpenCode in secure Runloop devboxes with a fast blueprint workflow.
Mount pre-configured AI agents to your Devboxes
Agent Gateways let your agents call LLM APIs like Anthropic and OpenAI **without ever seeing your API keys**.
